purpose: Select one genuinely independent Campaign040 mechanism without reading minute candidate values, comparison values, daily prices, or historical returns.

candidate_queue_review.reason: It measures whether uncertainty is distributed across clock time similarly in the two half sessions using high/low-only probability profiles. It does not use close returns, activity, a fitted trend, a market benchmark, disclosure timing, or any terminal factor value.
A single pooled entropy would be a direct distributional analogue of terminal amount entropy and return-variance entropy and could also re-express sparse zero-range bars.
Pearson correlation would be too close in estimator and ordinal alignment to Campaign027 return-profile persistence and in range dynamics to Campaign023 boundary translation coherence.
A two-bin magnitude split would invite subwindow timing interpretation and discard the preregistered 120-position distributional mechanism.
Signed serial dependence and time irreversibility are already terminally covered, and jump share is a monotone complement of the terminal bipower-to-realized-variance factor.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_range_profile_similarity_120b
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A more repeatable morning-versus-afternoon clock-time distribution of intrabar uncertainty may indicate stable liquidity provision and orderly information assimilation rather than a one-off afternoon shock, which may remain relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For j=0..119, let x_j=log(morning_high_j/morning_low_j) and y_j=log(afternoon_high_j/afternoon_low_j). Let X=sum(x), Y=sum(y), p_j=x_j/X, q_j=y_j/Y, and m_j=(p_j+q_j)/2. Let JSD=0.5*sum_{p_j>0}(p_j*log(p_j/m_j))+0.5*sum_{q_j>0}(q_j*log(q_j/m_j)), using 0*log(0)=0. Return 1-JSD/log(2).

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value mechanism-overlap audit and bind its exact formula, direction, source projection, zero semantics, and forbidden variants before any candidate value is computed.
